constraints.name: PermissionGrant_qualifier_check
constraints.expression: (("qualifierMode" IN ('none', 'any') AND "qualifierValue" IS NULL) OR ("qualifierMode" IN ('category', 'exact') AND "qualifierValue" IS NOT NULL AND length(trim("qualifierValue")) > 0))

constraints.name: PermissionGrant_scope_check
constraints.expression: (("scopeKind" = 'global' AND "projectId" IS NULL AND "sessionId" IS NULL) OR ("scopeKind" = 'project' AND "projectId" IS NOT NULL AND "sessionId" IS NULL) OR ("scopeKind" = 'session' AND "projectId" IS NOT NULL AND "sessionId" IS NOT NULL))

constraints.name: ArtifactVersionInput_sourceIdentity_check
constraints.expression: (("sourceKind" = 'artifact-version' AND "sourceArtifactVersionId" IS NOT NULL AND "sourceUploadVersionId" IS NULL AND "inputFileVersionId" = "sourceArtifactVersionId") OR ("sourceKind" = 'upload-version' AND "sourceArtifactVersionId" IS NULL AND "sourceUploadVersionId" IS NOT NULL AND "inputFileVersionId" = "sourceUploadVersionId"))
